summary: Exact candidate ad222b0 reproduced the reviewed defect: two distinct requested DSpark draft adapter identities are both replaced by one server-wide fixed adapter. The candidate correctly supports only a narrower fixed-adapter mode, not the request-selectable feature.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate commit, its two focused mocked tests passed and confirmed fixed draft-adapter initialization and routing.
A direct two-request regression expected task-a-adapter and task-b-adapter but observed server-wide-fixed-adapter for both draft rows.

gpu_evidence: No GPU claim is made. No compatible DSpark checkpoint plus stage-2 adapters was available; the provided tiny Llama fixture cannot validate DSpark architecture or adapter semantics.
remaining_limitations: No independent request-level DSpark draft adapter path or ID exists.
No separate multi-adapter DSpark registry, reference counting, dynamic load/unload protocol, or scheduler admission/draining policy exists.
Mixed-adapter DSpark CUDA-graph capture/replay and real-weight numerical behavior remain unverified.
The alternative multi-draft-model design is not implemented.

A complete correction requires coordinated API, tokenizer-manager, scheduler, draft-worker, LoRA-manager, and CUDA-graph lifecycle design; changing only draft ForwardBatch routing would accept unloaded or architecture-incompatible IDs.
